title: PBFuzz: Agentic Directed Fuzzing for PoV Generation
abstract: arXiv:2512.04611v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Proof-of-Vulnerability (PoV) input generation is a critical task in software security and supports downstream applications such as bug reproduction and patch validation. Generating a PoV input requires solving two sets of constraints: (1) reachability constraints for reaching vulnerable code locations, and (2) triggering constraints for activating the target vulnerability. Existing approaches, including directed greybox fuzzing and LLM-assisted fuzzing, struggle to efficiently satisfy these constraints.   This work presents an agentic method that mimics human experts. Human analysts iteratively study code to extract semantic reachability and triggering constraints, form hypotheses about PoV triggering strategies, encode them as test inputs, and refine their understanding using debugging feedback. We automate this process with an agentic directed fuzzing framework called PBFuzz. PBFuzz tackles four challenges in agentic PoV gene

translated_title: PBFuzz：面向PoV生成的智能体式定向模糊测试
translated_abstract: 漏洞证明输入生成是软件安全中的一项关键任务，支持漏洞复现和补丁验证等下游应用。生成PoV输入需要解决两组约束：（1）到达漏洞代码位置的可达性约束，（2）激活目标漏洞的触发约束。现有方法（包括定向灰盒模糊测试和LLM辅助模糊测试）难以高效地满足这些约束。本工作提出了一种模仿人类专家的智能体方法。人类分析师会迭代地研究代码以提取语义可达性和触发约束，形成关于PoV触发策略的假设，将其编码为测试输入，并利用调试反馈来完善他们的理解。我们通过一个名为PBFuzz的智能体式定向模糊测试框架将这一过程自动化。PBFuzz解决了智能体PoV生成中的四个挑战……
tldr: 本文提出PBFuzz，一种模仿人类专家工作方式的智能体式定向模糊测试框架，通过迭代提取语义约束、形成触发假设并利用调试反馈，高效生成漏洞证明输入。
en_tdlr: This paper presents PBFuzz, an agentic directed fuzzing framework that mimics human experts by iteratively extracting semantic reachability and triggering constraints, forming triggering hypotheses, and refining understanding through debugging feedback to efficiently generate Proof-of-Vulnerability (PoV) inputs.
